products.name: SAP Commerce Cloud
runtimeDependencies: JDK/Spring version depends on update line
deprecations: Accelerator UI and older OCC templates/AddOns have planned removal
products.upgradeImplications: Monthly/update-line compatibility and deprecation review required.

products.name: SAP Commerce Cloud, composable storefront
runtimeDependencies: Angular and Node.js versions must match the dependency matrix
deprecations: Open-source 4.x and earlier are not supported according to current dependency documentation
products.upgradeImplications: Feature levels, Angular/Node migration, standalone bootstrap, hydration, and accessibility rollout require versioned testing.

products.name: SAP Commerce Accelerator storefront
runtimeDependencies: JSP/Spring MVC/AddOn architecture varies by release
deprecations: Do not select for new development
products.upgradeImplications: Inventory custom AddOns and migrate to supported headless/storefront extension patterns.

products.name: Backoffice Administration Cockpit
deprecations: Legacy Product Cockpit content must be labeled deprecated
products.upgradeImplications: Custom widgets/configuration require regression and permission testing.

products.name: SAP Commerce Cloud Administration Console
runtimeDependencies: backend endpoint configured through Cloud Portal
products.upgradeImplications: Access, scripting, and production procedures must be constrained by role and runbook.

products.name: SAP Commerce Cloud Cloud Portal
products.upgradeImplications: Customer controls application configuration and deployment choices; SAP controls provider-managed cluster operations.

products.name: Dynatrace monitoring for SAP Commerce Cloud
products.upgradeImplications: Availability of individual monitoring features can vary; use SAP support for managed capabilities.
